Multiple Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) Prepare for Listing Amidst SEBI Deadline

As a Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) deadline approaches, Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) totaling approximately ₹38,000 crore are assessing their listing plans. Ten IPOs are open for bids starting September 9, representing ₹6,950 crore in value. Of these, six began subscription on the specified date, three are in their second day of bidding, and one, Pranav Constructions IPO, is on its final day. Investors are evaluating which of these issues hold the most potential for listing gains.
